accent.rule: Nunca fixar o tema da captura; tinta clara para acento colorido e tinta escura para branco/quase branco.

elevation.default: Tonal layering; avoid decorative outlines and generic shadows.
elevation.glow: Not a default focus treatment. Reserve gfx_luz_canto/GFX_SOMBRA for explicitly approved ambient surfaces.

motion.principle: Motion clarifies focus and transition; never carries meaning by itself.
motion.reducedMotion: Remove transitions while retaining the complete selected state.

componentExamples.name: episode-row-rest
componentExamples.nativeSpec: Selectable content card; rounded dark surface #101114; clear title and metadata; no decorative border.

componentExamples.name: episode-row-focused
componentExamples.nativeSpec: Approach A: restrained dark accent wash derived from the active theme, light text, preserved poster ratio; no glow.

componentExamples.name: focused-content-row
componentExamples.nativeSpec: Source, episode actions, saved/social/alerts side panels, and the expanded global menu use a solid theme-accent fill on the focused item, contrast-aware ink, and a soft restrained accent halo behind it. Keep inactive surfaces neutral; no glass, gradient, top reflection, or improvised outline. The corner notification toast stays matte neutral with an accent icon and soft halo.

componentExamples.name: close-ghost
componentExamples.nativeSpec: No box at rest; subtle neutral surface and standard focus cue only while selected.
